ABOUT THIS BUILD

CREDITS

ENGINE

NOVABEAT ENGINE

A custom enhancement layer built around the original Friday Night Funkin' experience. The intent is to add quality-of-life systems and new tools without replacing the characters, music, stages or identity of the original game.

FOUNDATION

FRIDAY NIGHT FUNKIN'

Built on the official FNF 0.8.6 source foundation. The original menu remains the upstream implementation and is selected directly when Original FNF menu style is enabled.
